name: widget-data
description: Local Expo module: bridges JS to the Today's Panchang home-screen widgets' shared storage. Android: a native module writing SharedPreferences (dharmagya_widget_prefs / today_panchang_payload) and pinging the AppWidgetProvider. iOS: no native code here — index.ios.ts writes the App Group UserDefaults through @bacons/apple-targets' ExtensionStorage and reloads the WidgetKit timeline.
